mechanism: Primidone is a potent CYP450 enzyme inducer (CYP3A4, CYP2C9, CYP2C19) that increases melatonin metabolism, potentially reducing melatonin efficacy; both agents have CNS effects that may be additive.
action: Monitor for reduced melatonin efficacy; consider dose adjustment of melatonin if used for sleep support; counsel patient on potential additive CNS depression.
